correctness.rationale: Positive definite Lyapunov and innovation covariances make the Gaussian KL finite. Exact 4x4 Gaussian KL reduces algebraically to the invariant 2x2 formula; Cayley–Hamilton controls distinct-real, repeated-real and complex-conjugate drifts without a diagonalizability gap. A sampled transition is symmetric in stationary-whitened coordinates exactly at the claimed lags. At each zero the scalar lag transition and Taylor expansion give the stated positive coefficient. The rotational specialization reproduces the stationary-current physical EPR, and the Dey expansion yields the inverse-foresight lag and positive entropy-per-lag limit. A package-local independent Gaussian covariance checker passed 2120 assertions.

evidence: Dey provides the Nash drift B and short-foresight coefficients: direct substitution alone does not determine the finite-lag KL or all-zero classification.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The proof requires an independently established exact Gaussian relative-entropy identity plus a complete Cayley–Hamilton analysis. A stronger general time-sampling nonidentifiability theorem may explain the physical phenomenon, but does not explicitly imply the derived scalar closed form or the quadratic coefficient without additional Gaussian-specific calculations.

evidence: Dey Sections 3 and 5 compute steady-state physical rate, not swapped-two-time KL.
Bauer et al. Sections 3-4 address finite-state generator inverse-log ambiguity and entropy inference.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The candidate can be rephrased as symmetric whitened lag propagator, stationary Gaussian detailed balance, or vanishing reversed-pair KL. Each equivalent statement was compared with the cited primary sources; none of those inspected statements gives the exact planar all-diffusions characterization.

evidence: The exact Gaussian expression is a continuous-parameter analytic formula, not a finite tabulated constant.
The motivating source has stationary EPR formulas and plotting, but no exact sampled KL table.
exact_database_or_table.reasoning: The work is not an enumeration or repetition of published tabular values; mathematical research record searches also found no claim-wise match for the oscillatory sampled OU two-time law. Absence from a database is not a proof of priority.

originality.rationale: Exact sampled-Gaussian KL identity, global planar spectral zero-set and local quadratic information profile are not supplied by the compared 2026 OU papers, the motivating Nash game, or the 2024 finite-state stroboscopic analysis; the latter establishes the broader idea of sampling aliases. Accessible records did not show a stronger implication. Qualified best-knowledge with explicit residual risks.
residual_risks: Older multidimensional Gaussian entropy-production or AR(1) literature could implicitly contain the exact KL determinant identity and all-zero half-turn classification.
A general stochastic-semigroup sampling-alias theorem could subsume the spectral zero-set without stating the quadratic information coefficient.
The 2026 OU decomposition paper was examined in accessible main-text material but not every appendix; no whole-document noncoverage is asserted.
Independent priority verification has not been performed.

Lucente et al. (2022) and related incomplete-observation work may contain finite-lag covariance identities beyond the scalar Gaussian statement visible in accessible abstract; full primary text was not inspected here.

value.rationale: Full-state stationary time-sampled reversibility can be false evidence for physical equilibrium, so the exact set of observational blind spots, the sharp real-vs-complex drift dichotomy and information recovery quadratically away from aliases are naturally valuable for thermodynamic inference. It includes arbitrary positive-definite anisotropic noise and defective real drifts and a concrete current 2026 stochastic-game instance. Neither correct KL arithmetic nor a known general alias idea alone is claimed valuable; the complete classification and controlled information profile are the substantive advance.
